title: Photo post (Instagram-style)
description: A square photo post in an Instagram-style feed. The photo comes from the image slot; the caption carries the message. Captions are casual, with emojis spelled out as words and a run of hashtags at the end.

timestampRel.description: Relative post age shown next to the handle

imageBrief.description: Image-generation brief for the photo slot (media stage only; square; never rely on legible text in it)
examples: very long security line through a bright terminal atrium, phone photo from above

likes.description: Like count: a number (abbreviated automatically, 12400 → 12.4K) or the exact text the app shows

examples: Security line goes past the food court. Nobody knows anything. #NCIA #travelfail
